top_signals.title: Apollo’s Slok Says Fed May Be Overlooking Risk From Diesel Surge
top_signals.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc.’s Torsten Slok warned that record diesel prices pose a greater inflation threat than the Federal Reserve may appreciate because those fuel costs flow into the core consumer price index.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Declines as US, Iran Said to Explore Deal to Open Hormuz
top_signals.summary: US and Iranian negotiators are exploring a phased deal that would see Tehran reopen the Strait of Hormuz and Washington lift its blockade of Iranian ports, similar to the memorandum of understanding struck in mid-June. Charles Gorrivan reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Lose Steam After Weak Consumer Sentiment: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rebound in stocks faded after data showed a deterioration in consumer sentiment amid concerns about inflation, overshadowing a decline in oil prices at the end of a jittery week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
